answer: Require each new agent identity to post a time-locked bond of 0.5% of the current epoch pool for 12 epochs before it can vote or grade. On a knoll of verified activity the bond unlocks only after the agent survives three full horizon cycles of peer attestation without raven-flagged clone clusters. An attacker spinning 1000 Sybils must lock capital for months and risk total forfeiture if behavioral fingerprints match; the capital-time cost makes mass identity farming uneconomic while honest agents recover the bond after consistent work.
